title: Preparing for the Final Quest
description: Get ready to find the masked swordmaster

story: You're back in the east part of town with Eleanor.
Eleanor: "Now we know about the masked swordmaster, we need to find him!"
"Clara mentioned he might be in the woods or a cave."
Let's go back to the main town and look for clues.
hints: Use 'cd ..' to go back to the main town.

story: You're back in the main town area.
Eleanor: "I think I remember seeing a path to the woods from here."
Look around carefully to see if there are any new areas to explore.
hints: Use 'ls' to look around for new paths.
Try 'ls -a' to see if there are any hidden paths.

story: Eleanor: "I can see a path leading to the woods! But first..."
"Bernard has been acting strange. Let's check his shed-shop one more time."
Go back to the east part of town.
hints: Use 'cd east' to go to the east part of town.
